gloss: superficial knowledge; hastily acquired skill; slapdash preparation

definitions.gloss: superficial knowledge; hastily acquired skill; slapdash preparation
definitions.explanation: Knowledge or skills that were quickly crammed or picked up at the last minute, without genuine understanding or mastery. Implies that such preparation will not hold up under pressure.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧。
examples.english: Superficial knowledge will be found out quickly.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{案|あん}の{定|じょう}→案の定：07578_annojou⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went into the exam with hastily crammed knowledge, and sure enough, I failed.

examples.japanese: {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{根本的|こんぽんてき}→根本的：17920_konponteki⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}できない→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: Slapdash measures cannot solve fundamental problems.

notes:
Literally means "attached tempered blade" — a cheap blade with a thin layer of hard steel welded onto it. Such blades look sharp but quickly become dull, just as hastily acquired knowledge or skills crumble under real-world use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧: superficial knowledge
- {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: hasty countermeasures
- {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧: last-minute cramming
- {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{通用|つうよう}→通用：04530_tsuuyou⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: superficial skills won't cut it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一夜漬|いちやづ}け→一夜漬け：25616_ichiyazuke⟧: overnight cramming — specifically cramming the night before an exam
- にわか{仕込|じこ}み: hastily learned — similar idea of quickly picked-up skills
- ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧しのぎ: stopgap — a temporary fix that doesn't address the root cause

ETYMOLOGY:
From swordsmithing: a {付|つ}け{焼|や}き{刃|ば} is a blade where hard steel is merely attached to the surface rather than forged properly. It cuts at first but dulls quickly — a perfect metaphor for shallow preparation.
